title: Tooltips render far above the hovered element in 1.65.0
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

Starting in 1.65.0, pydeck tooltips appear far above the hovered object, often off-screen.
The same app works correctly on 1.64.0.

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
import pydeck as pdk
import streamlit as st

st.write(f"Streamlit {st.__version__}")

data = [{"position": [-98.35, 39.5], "name": "Test point"}]

st.pydeck_chart(
    pdk.Deck(
        initial_view_state=pdk.ViewState(latitude=39.5, longitude=-98.35, zoom=4),
        layers=[pdk.Layer("ScatterplotLayer", data, pickable=True, get_position="position",
                          get_fill_color=[255, 0, 0], radius_min_pixels=10)],
        tooltip={"text": "{name}"},
    )
)
```

### Steps To Reproduce

Run the app with streamlit==1.65.0.
Hover over the red dot.

### Expected Behavior

Tooltip appears next to the cursor, as it does in 1.64.0.

### Current Behavior

Tooltip appears offset far above the cursor, often off-screen.

### Is this a regression?

- [x] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.65.0 (bug), 1.64.0 (works)
- Python version: 3.13
- pydeck 0.9.3
- Operating System: macOS
- Browser: Safari version 27

### Additional Information

Possibly related: 1.65.0 changed st.pydeck_chart (new alt parameter, PR #17086).

This is a regression in `st.pydeck_chart` hover tooltips. On 1.65.0 the tooltip is drawn far above the hovered object and often off-screen; the same app is correct on 1.64.0. The new `alt` parameter (#17086) only sets an accessible name and does not affect placement.

1.65.0 bumped `[USER].gl/*` from 9.3.11 to 9.4.0 (#16924). deck.gl 9.4 (`TooltipWidget.onHover`, visgl/deck.gl#10491) positions the tooltip at `info.x/y` plus `getCanvasBounds()`, which is the canvas rectangle minus the `.deck-widgets-root` rectangle. `[USER].gl/react` renders that root as an unstyled sibling after `.deck-events-root` (`height: 100%`). The root therefore sits at the bottom of the chart, while the tooltip is absolutely positioned against the chart wrapper. For the default 500px chart that subtracts about one chart-height from the tooltip `translateY`, which matches a tooltip landing far above the cursor. Streamlit’s `createTooltip` in `useDeckGl.tsx` only supplies text or HTML; it does not set coordinates.

### Related Issues

No open issue looks like a duplicate of this positioning regression.

- [#2242](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/2242) is an older, closed report about pydeck tooltips together with a basemap when embedding deck HTML. It is a different problem and should not be treated as a duplicate.
